exports.normalizeResolvedSecretInputString: Records input/path and trims explicit dummy strings only. No real secret resolution or credential authority executes; ordinary inputs carry no credentials.

exports.assertOkOrThrowProviderError: Named synthetic ordinary-success status facade records response identity/label/options only. Original status/error behavior is unexecuted.
exports.readProviderBinaryResponse: Named synthetic ordinary-success body facade records response identity/label/kind/options and returns eight opaque recipe bytes. Original body reader, limits and deadlines are unexecuted.

exports.ssrfPolicyFromHttpBaseUrlAllowedHostname: Records source-produced base URL and supplies an opaque synthetic policy. No hostname, TLS or network-policy algorithm executes; fields are provenance only.

exports.resolveGeneratedMediaMaxBytes: Named synthetic ordinary-success media-cap facade records cfg/kind and returns a fixed non-boundary fixture cap. No configuration, cap, budget or overflow semantics are qualified.

exports.resolveApiKeyForProvider: Named positive dummy facade returns a fixed fixture key. Source arguments/header construction are provenance only; profiles, stores, environment fallback, credential selection and authentication are unqualified.
exports.fetchWithSsrFGuard: Named synthetic ordinary-success context facade records exact source request/body/timeout and returns a synthetic successful response containing eight opaque bytes plus counted release. No real network or guard executes.

globalBoundaries.process: Isolated VM process.env={} only; no ambient credentials, profile store, fallback or configured predicate is exercised.
globalBoundaries.fetch: Throwing ambient binding; only the named synthetic successful context guarded-fetch facade is invoked.
globalBoundaries.Buffer: Native Buffer carries eight opaque synthetic bytes; no real audio format, codec or playback is established.
globalBoundaries.clock: Source passes raw ordinary request timeouts to the synthetic context guard. VM and asynchronous deadlines bound harness execution only; no source timeout behavior is qualified.

limits: All 58558 pinned tracked blobs/modes are verified before and after; complete original executable modules match pinned Git bytes before TypeScript erasure only.
Seven whole original runtime modules evaluate: speech provider/base URL, string/record/number normalization, directive parser/number. Whole-module evaluation is not all-branch execution.
Original factory, metadata, resolveConfig, resolveTalkConfig, resolveTalkOverrides, static listVoices, buffered synthesis and telephony execute ordinary positive recipes.
Original directive parser construction executes; directive dispatch and isConfigured/isConfiguredAsync are never invoked.

Original alias precedence, Talk overlay, exact text/JSON request construction, base-URL normalization, output format, file extension, Opus voiceCompatible and telephony 24000 Hz result metadata execute.

Original auth call and header assembly execute only with a fixed named dummy context resolver; captured credential/header/policy fields are provenance, not authentication, credential-selection, permission, policy or TLS qualification.

Secret normalization, status, binary read, media cap, policy and guarded HTTP are named positive synthetic facades. Eight opaque successful response bytes and counted release do not establish network, real media, codec or limit behavior.
Manifest, index, capability catalog and license are complete original unevaluated provenance data; plugin activation, registration and production Synapsis installation are unexecuted.
No security/permission/authTLS, negative/error/failure/cancel/crash, mixed, budget/truncation/eviction/threshold/race, real provider or remote MCP execution.
